description: Full-stack Preact framework on Vite: an explicit route manifest, per-route SSG/SSR/ISG/SPA rendering, loaders, API routes, islands, and typed capabilities exposed to agents over HTTP, WebMCP, and remote MCP. Adapters for Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Netlify, Node.js, and static hosts.
rules: Components are Preact, not React: import hooks from `preact/hooks` and prefer `class` over `className`.
Wire routes, shells, middleware, and render modes in `src/routes.ts` with `defineApp()`, or use the file-system `src/pages/` router.
Choose a render mode per route (`ssg`, `ssr`, `isg`, `spa`); fetch data in a route `loader` and handle mutations in `src/api/` routes.
Scaffold with `pracht generate route|shell|middleware|api|capability` instead of hand-writing wiring, then run `pracht verify`.
Docs for the installed version: run `pracht docs <topic>`; the site is https://pracht.resynapse.dev and its index is /llms.txt.
